Jordan (CSM): @Luca quick check — onboarding metrics look healthy but we noticed a growing p95 tail on /chat during peak commute windows. renewal touchpoint in 3 weeks, would like to propose low-risk perf options. any blockers for quant builds or routing experiments?

Luca (VelaDrive): Were on Private in eu-west and compliance requires artifact checksums, but we can canary changes. Primary traffic is short receipts (~60%) and medium itinerary summaries (~30%). Cannot change reserved capacity pre-renewal.

Kai (Solutions Eng): Low-friction wins: 1) route short receipts to a q4 quantized small model, 2) enable prefix KV caching for repeated trip templates, 3) tighten batching for medium gens to reduce tail. Example route we can stage:
```yaml
routes:
  - match: {intent: "receipt", tokens: "<140"}
    target: redwood/phoenix-6b-q4
  - match: {intent: "itinerary_summary", tokens: ">140"}
    target: redwood/aurora-20b
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  keys: ["trip_template_v3"]
inference:
  batching:
    max_batch_latency_ms: 12
```

Sana (Product): Recommend a conservative canary flow: 1% -> 5% over 4h with monitors: p95, error_rate, and a small quality smoke set (10 golden receipts, 15 summaries). Auto-rollback if p95 increases >18% or quality drop >2%. Also add a token-usage probe so we can estimate cost impact for renewal.

Luca (VelaDrive): 1%->5% fine. Compliance will need the binary checksum (48h) and a short integrity report. Avoid canary overlap with our nightly DB job at 02:30 CET. Also wed like a 10% canary variant that forces routing only for our mobile short flows (less risk).

Kai (Solutions Eng): We can do both: start with 1% global -> 5% then run a targeted 10% mobile-only route after validation. Canary config example:
```json
{
  "canary": {"start_pct": 1, "ramp_to_pct": 5, "ramp_hours": 4},
  "monitors": ["p95","error_rate","quality_score"],
  "auto_rollback": {"p95_increase_pct": 18, "quality_drop_pct": 2}
}
```

review-bot: Note: Private maintenance in eu-west at 2039879000. Rollouts paused during the window.

Jordan (CSM): action items: Kai to produce vetted q4 artifact + checksum; Sana to add golden prompts and hook up quality probes; Luca to confirm compliance slot and mobile fraction for targeted canary. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement + security walk-through for Tue 09:30 CET.

Luca (VelaDrive): Will provide checksum contact and mobile traffic fraction (~38%) by EOD. One ask: wed like the canary to include a short A/B on reply length vs completeness for receipts; product team will check UX impact.

Sana (Product): Noted — will include a length vs completeness A/B probe inside the canary and track token delta. Please share 10 golden receipts and 15 summaries for the eval set.

Kai (Solutions Eng): Playbook snippets for quick operations: `redwood canary start --route /chat --artifact phoenix-6b-q4 --percent 1` and rollback `redwood canary abort --id veladrive-receipts` or `redwood rollback --route /chat --to stable`. I'll also prepare cost delta estimates for the playbook.

Jordan (CSM): capturing for renewal brief: target outcome = p95 reduction ~15-25% during peak, tokens per short receipt ~12-20% lower, and no >2% quality regression. Results will feed renewal packet. :spiral_notepad:

Luca (VelaDrive): Sounds good. No blockers from our side. Thanks team — looking forward to the enablement session. :thumbsup:
